tldr: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash first showed up in deployments: Dolphin's inference API went live Oct 11 and AMD MI355X posted AA-AgentPerf results Oct 14. Two OrcaRouter comparisons on Oct 16 then priced it against Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Step 5 Preview.
whats_new: DeepSeek shipped V4.1 Flash-1017 on Oct 17 with stronger coding and agent performance, lower inference cost and a first public search API; The Decoder says it beats larger rivals on agentic tasks.
why_it_matters: The update cuts per-task cost on agentic workloads and adds a first-party search API, so cost-per-task comparisons and search tool choices in agent stacks need rerunning.

status.detail: Flash-1017 is out; Harness v0.2.1-rc1 surfaced alongside an unannounced snapshot.

beats.headline: V4.1 Flash reaches inference providers and AMD benchmarks
OrcaRouter prices Flash against Nemotron 3.5 and Step 5 Preview
Flash-1017 ships with stronger coding, cheaper inference and a search API
beats.summary: Harness v0.2.1-rc1 surfaced the same day with an unannounced snapshot.

beats.headline: Open-model roundup places Flash-1017 among current releases

open_questions: Do independent evals confirm Flash-1017's agentic gains over larger rivals?
Is the new search API priced and rate-limited for production use?
Is the unannounced snapshot a separate model or the same Flash-1017?
take_for_builders: Rerun your agent eval and cost-per-task numbers on Flash-1017 before switching, and test the search API against your current tool before replacing it.
